name: facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-baselines/habitat_baselines/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.batch_observations_for_rl: batch a list of observation dicts into a TensorDict for GPU training
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.generate_video_from_images: generate a video from a list of numpy images and save to disk or tensorboard
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.resize_image_shortest_edge: resize an image tensor so the shortest edge matches a target size while preserving aspect ratio
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.create_gaussian_policy_net: create a GaussianNet module for continuous action policy output with configurable std and activation

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.filter_non_scalar_metrics: filter out non-scalar metrics like top_down_map and collisions from environment info dictionaries
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.flatten_nested_info_dict: flatten nested environment info dictionary keys into dot-separated scalar key-value pairs
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.customize_ignore_keys: customize which info dictionary keys to exclude when extracting scalar values from gym env info

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.create_timing_dict: create a Timing dict instance to track elapsed time for multiple named keys
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.use_timing_context: use a TimingContext as a context manager or decorator to time a code block
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.add_additive_time: use add_time on a Timing instance to accumulate elapsed time for a key
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.use_avg_time: use avg_time on a Timing instance to track a running average of elapsed time
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-bas.use_global_timer: use the global g_timer singleton to record and report timing metrics
